description: At-a-glance comparison of choreography and orchestration saga health, latency, rollback activity, traces, and logs.
title: Saga Pattern: Choreography vs Orchestration

promql.name: A
promql.query: sum by (step, direction, result) ({__name__="saga_framework_step_duration_seconds.sum"}) / clamp_min(sum by (step, direction, result) ({__name__="saga_framework_step_duration_seconds.count"}), 1)

widgets.title: Rollback Progress
widgets.description: Started versus completed compensation counters; gaps indicate stuck recovery.

widgets.title: Slowest Spans
widgets.description: Ranks saga operations by average span time; p95 and p99 expose tail-latency hotspots.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
SELECT
  serviceName         AS service,
  name                AS operation,
  count()             AS spans,
  round(avg(duration_nano) / 1e6, 2) AS avg_ms,
  round(quantile(0.95)(duration_nano) / 1e6, 2) AS p95_ms,
  round(quantile(0.99)(duration_nano) / 1e6, 2) AS p99_ms,
  round(max(duration_nano) / 1e6, 2) AS max_ms
FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3
WHERE timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Nano({{.start_timestamp_nano}})
  AND timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Nano({{.end_timestamp_nano}})
  AND attributes_string['http.route'] NOT LIKE '/actuator/%'
  AND name NOT LIKE '%/actuator/%'
  AND (
    serviceName LIKE '%choreography%'
    OR serviceName LIKE '%orchestration%'
  )
GROUP BY serviceName, name
ORDER BY avg_ms DESC
LIMIT 50

widgets.title: Failure Types
widgets.description: Groups failed saga spans by type, step, and pattern so the dominant failure mode is visible first.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
SELECT
  attributes_string['failure.type']  AS failure_type,
  attributes_string['saga.step']     AS saga_step,
  attributes_string['saga.pattern']  AS saga_pattern,
  count()                            AS occurrences,
  min(timestamp)                     AS first_seen,
  max(timestamp)                     AS last_seen
FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3
WHERE timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Nano({{.start_timestamp_nano}})
  AND timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Nano({{.end_timestamp_nano}})
  AND attributes_string['http.route'] NOT LIKE '/actuator/%'
  AND name NOT LIKE '%/actuator/%'
  AND attributes_string['failure.type'] != ''
GROUP BY failure_type, saga_step, saga_pattern
ORDER BY occurrences DESC
LIMIT 50

widgets.title: Order Journey Trace Summary
widgets.description: One row per trace with order, pattern, state, failure, journey time, slowest span, and drilldown links.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
SELECT
  pattern,
  order_id,
  request_id,
  final_state,
  steps,
  failure_type,
  first_seen,
  last_seen,
  round((toUnixTimestamp64Nano(last_seen) - toUnixTimestamp64Nano(first_seen)) / 1e6, 2) AS journey_ms,
  max_span_ms,
  trace_id,
  span_id
FROM (
  SELECT
    trace_id,
    min(timestamp) AS first_seen,
    max(timestamp) AS last_seen,
    argMaxIf(
      span_id,
      timestamp,
      attributes_string['order.id'] != ''
        OR attributes_string['saga.step'] != ''
        OR attributes_string['saga.state'] != ''
        OR attributes_string['failure.type'] != ''
        OR name LIKE 'choreography.order%'
        OR name LIKE 'orchestration.order%'
    ) AS span_id,
    anyIf(attributes_string['request.id'], attributes_string['request.id'] != '') AS request_id,
    anyIf(attributes_string['order.id'], attributes_string['order.id'] != '') AS order_id,
    if(
      countIf(serviceName LIKE '%choreography%') > 0,
      'choreography',
      if(countIf(serviceName LIKE '%orchestration%') > 0, 'orchestration', anyIf(attributes_string['saga.pattern'], attributes_string['saga.pattern'] != ''))
    ) AS pattern,
    arrayStringConcat(arraySort(groupUniqArrayIf(attributes_string['saga.step'], attributes_string['saga.step'] != '')), ', ') AS steps,
    argMaxIf(attributes_string['saga.state'], timestamp, attributes_string['saga.state'] != '') AS saga_state,
    argMaxIf(attributes_string['saga.outcome'], timestamp, attributes_string['saga.outcome'] != '') AS saga_outcome,
    argMaxIf(attributes_string['order.result'], timestamp, attributes_string['order.result'] != '') AS order_result,
    anyIf(attributes_string['failure.type'], attributes_string['failure.type'] != '') AS failure_type,
    countIf(name LIKE '%shipping_scheduled%' OR name LIKE '%schedule_shipping%') AS completion_markers,
    round(max(duration_nano) / 1e6, 2) AS max_span_ms,
    multiIf(
      order_result != '', order_result,
      saga_state != '', saga_state,
      saga_outcome != '', saga_outcome,
      failure_type != '', 'FAILED',
      completion_markers > 0, 'COMPLETED',
      'UNKNOWN'
    ) AS final_state
  FROM signoz_traces.signoz_index_v3
  WHERE timestamp >= fromUnixTimestamp64Nano({{.start_timestamp_nano}})
    AND timestamp <= fromUnixTimestamp64Nano({{.end_timestamp_nano}})
    AND attributes_string['http.route'] NOT LIKE '/actuator/%'
    AND name NOT LIKE '%/actuator/%'
    AND (
      serviceName LIKE '%choreography%'
      OR serviceName LIKE '%orchestration%'
    )
  GROUP BY trace_id
)
WHERE
  (order_id != ''
  OR steps != ''
  OR final_state != 'UNKNOWN'
  OR failure_type != '')
  AND ('{{.pattern}}' = 'all' OR pattern = '{{.pattern}}')
ORDER BY last_seen DESC
LIMIT 100

widgets.title: HTTP Logs with Trace Links
widgets.description: Request logs with route, status, duration, request ID, and trace/span fallback extraction.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query:
SELECT
  fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(timestamp)              AS ts,
  resources_string['service.name']               AS service,
  attributes_string['http.request.method']        AS method,
  attributes_string['http.route']                 AS route,
  attributes_string['http.response.status_code']  AS status,
  attributes_string['http.request.duration_ms']   AS duration_ms,
  attributes_string['request.id']                 AS request_id,
  if(trace_id != '', trace_id, extract(body, 'trace_id=([0-9a-f]{32})')) AS trace_id,
  if(span_id != '', span_id, extract(body, 'span_id=([0-9a-f]{16})')) AS span_id,
  severity_text                                   AS level,
  body
FROM signoz_logs.logs_v2
WHERE timestamp >= {{.start_timestamp_nano}}
  AND timestamp <= {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
  AND attributes_string['http.route'] NOT LIKE '/actuator/%'
  AND body NOT LIKE '% route=/actuator/%'
  AND (
    attributes_string['http.route'] != ''
    OR body LIKE '%msg="http request completed"%'
  )
  AND resources_string['service.name'] != ''
  AND (
    resources_string['service.name'] LIKE '%choreography%'
    OR resources_string['service.name'] LIKE '%orchestration%'
  )
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 200
